_schema._about: One issue of the journal. The build renders three editions from this file: the web edition (the front page is the current issue), the circular (the e-mail pair under site/issues/), and the audio edition (one SSG podcast episode, its metadata emitted for podcast_publish_episode). scripts/check-issue.js is the gate: every href into the library resolves at HEAD, every section is a shelf id, every book is in site-src/books/, an external href is https, a planned item may lack an href, and nothing else may.
_schema.status: live | draft | planned — draft means the file exists and awaits the author's pass; planned means no file yet
_schema.author: the byline as printed; the author's ruling 2026-10-02: the Singularity pieces carry the LLM bylines, the rest are his
